title: damrongia lacunosa
intro: Damrongia lacunosa, commonly known as Thai mountain mint, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Damrongia lacunosa include pain relief, wound healing, and fever reduction, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
